capabilities.purpose: Read the authorized current projection of one known Urban Object.
capabilities.useWhen: Use when the caller already has the Urban Object identifier and needs current state.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for history, bulk search, graph exploration, raw payloads or analytics.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns one policy-filtered current projection or anti-enumeration not-found.
capabilities.securityNotes: Authorization, tenant isolation and field masking are applied before return; RAW is excluded.

capabilities.purpose: Read an authorized page of immutable canonical revisions for one Urban Object.
capabilities.useWhen: Use for audit, as-of investigation or change history of a known object.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for current-only reads, raw payload retrieval or cross-object analytics.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns an ordered, paginated and policy-filtered revision view.
capabilities.securityNotes: Historical values remain subject to current authorization and redaction policy.

capabilities.purpose: Find authorized current Urban Objects through indexed typed filters.
capabilities.useWhen: Use when the object identifier is unknown but canonical type and bounded filters are known.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for arbitrary expressions, unbounded wildcard scans, relationships or analytics.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns a bounded page of authorized current projections; it is not an exhaustive export.
capabilities.securityNotes: Only allowlisted filters and projections are accepted; policy filtering precedes return.

capabilities.purpose: Read authorized inbound or outbound relationships of one known Urban Object.
capabilities.useWhen: Use for a bounded relationship view around one object with known relation filters.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for recursion, cross-domain joins or graph-wide exploration.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns policy-visible edges without disclosing hidden degree or restricted endpoints.
capabilities.securityNotes: Relationship labels, tenant boundaries and anti-enumeration rules are enforced.

capabilities.purpose: Explain governed provenance and contract evidence for one Urban Object.
capabilities.useWhen: Use when the caller needs source, run, schema, mapping and authority evidence.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to obtain implicit RAW payloads or unrestricted source identifiers.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns filtered evidence references and may contain redacted fields.
capabilities.securityNotes: Source identifiers, property values and evidence are masked according to policy.

capabilities.purpose: Return one bounded hop of policy-visible graph adjacency for progressive exploration.
capabilities.useWhen: Use for exploratory navigation, then prune the candidate set before the next explicit hop.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not chain calls to simulate known cross-domain joins or bypass depth and cumulative budgets.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns bounded direct neighbors and visible edges; additional hops require explicit calls.
capabilities.securityNotes: Authorization and cumulative correlation budgets are enforced server-side.

capabilities.purpose: Traverse a bounded hierarchy, technical network or other intrinsically recursive structure.
capabilities.useWhen: Use only when recursion or hierarchy is intrinsic, such as variant chains or technical networks.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for cross-domain correlation, shared anchors, spatial patterns or typed joins.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns a bounded recursive result that may be truncated when an enforced limit is reached.
capabilities.securityNotes: The Capability Router remains authoritative; descriptions never authorize redirect or bypass.

capabilities.purpose: Correlate declared object classes through a known relationship pattern without recursion.
capabilities.useWhen: Use for typed cross-domain patterns such as Dehor and Worksite objects related to the same Street.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for unknown exploratory paths, recursive hierarchies, spatial predicates or analytics.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns policy-visible objects matching the declared anchor, direction, relation and target types.
capabilities.securityNotes: The input is typed and cannot contain SQL or physical-plan controls; tenant and labels are enforced.

capabilities.purpose: Find authorized objects of a declared type within a governed distance from an anchor.
capabilities.useWhen: Use for bounded distance-based discovery around a known visible object.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for arbitrary geometry expressions, global scans or non-spatial relationships.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns bounded authorized hits with distance in meters.
capabilities.securityNotes: Anchor visibility, target tenant and access labels are validated before return.

capabilities.purpose: Find authorized objects whose geometry intersects a governed envelope.
capabilities.useWhen: Use for bounded intersection against an EPSG:4326 envelope and declared target type.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for unsupported CRS, oversized areas, arbitrary predicates or cross-domain joins.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns a bounded set of policy-visible objects intersecting the envelope.
capabilities.securityNotes: Geometry, tenant and access-label controls are enforced server-side.

capabilities.purpose: Find authorized objects whose geometry lies within a governed envelope.
capabilities.useWhen: Use for bounded containment against an EPSG:4326 envelope and declared target type.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for unsupported CRS, oversized areas, arbitrary predicates or proximity ranking.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns a bounded set of policy-visible objects contained by the envelope.
capabilities.securityNotes: Geometry, tenant and access-label controls are enforced server-side.

capabilities.purpose: Correlate declared object types through a governed spatial or topological intersection.
capabilities.useWhen: Use for cross-domain spatial correlation around a known visible anchor.
capabilities.doNotUseWhen: Do not use for non-spatial typed relationships, recursive paths or arbitrary geometry languages.
capabilities.resultSemantics: Returns bounded policy-visible target objects intersecting the anchor geometry.
capabilities.securityNotes: Anchor/target types, tenant, geometry validity, labels and cost budget are governed.
